g.text: Combos set in Argos: W+F = copy, R+S = paste. Func layer: Wipe = clear stored settings, Boot = flash mode.
Toggle: hold Esc thumb, tap the left bottom inner key. Mods, thumbs and all four held layers are the same as above.
Gaming: double-tap / to enter and leave. Mouse: turns on when the ball moves (or hold B); any other key returns to typing.
